acceptanceCriteria: The test deadline is decoupled from the simulated host kill, so a slow node startup cannot fail the no-budget case, while the test still proves Corvint is not spawned.
The suite passes under parallel CPU load.
body: Seen 2026-09-25 in the v0-6 release make gate at 3c1b894c (host load average 557): integrations/host-adapters.test.mjs:117 'AHI-017 Gemini degrades without spawning Corvint when the host kill leaves no budget' failed with 'hook test deadline'. geminiOnce (host-adapters.test.mjs:56) rejects after kill+1000 ms; with kill=1 that allows about 1 s for node to start the hook and answer. Neighbouring Gemini subtests took 7-9 s in the same run. make gate therefore fails on a loaded host without a product defect.
title: Gemini hook no-budget test fails under host load: 1 s spawn deadline
